name: Johan Danielsson - § 11/2
title: REPORT on addressing subcontracting chains and the role of intermediaries in order to protect workers’ rights
part_text: calls on the Commission to propose a framework to limit subcontracting chains with a focus on addressing issues in high-risk sectors;
part_context: Notes that the length and complexity of subcontracting chains pose a significant challenge to labour inspectorates in establishing legal responsibility for labour law violations, which needs to be tackled; calls on the Commission to propose a framework to limit subcontracting chains with a focus on addressing issues in high-risk sectors;
